paraphrase: The external introduction narrates the three councils; at the third, under Asoka, Moggaliputta Tissa purified the Saṅgha, recited the Kathāvatthu and sent elders to the border countries — Mahinda to Lanka and Soṇa and Uttara to Suvaṇṇabhūmi.
